title: A Falsified Bar-Instability Criterion Reveals an Independent Disk-State Parameter from EFC-Modified Disk Kinematics
description: This Stage-1 empirical test falsifies an EFC-modified Toomre-Q bar-instability criterion on SPARC galaxies (AUC 0.22–0.31; anti-correlated with bar truth within the physically allowed ζ range). In the same data, the minimum ΠEFC within the disk window shows strong, replicable correlations with disk structural state (anti-correlated with stellar surface density and positively correlated with gas fraction) across SPARC and xGASS, motivating Πmin as a candidate disk-state parameter on the joint (Σ, fgas) manifold.

Pi_EFC.description: EFC-modified Toomre-like stability parameter evaluated as the product of radial velocity dispersion and effective epicyclic frequency over the standard surface-density normalization.

kappa_eff.description: Effective epicyclic frequency including an EFC entropy-flow coupling term scaled by dimensionless ζ and radial acceleration contribution g_EFC.

g_EFC_shear.description: Shear-based entropy-flow acceleration proxy used in v0.2 and in v0.1(shear), with α derived from the EFC latency fraction per galaxy.

alt_entropy_gradient_proxy.description: Original longitudinal entropy-gradient proxy used in v0.1, found to have the wrong sign for destabilization in rising rotation-curve regions.

key_results.main_finding: The EFC bar-instability criterion fails as a bar predictor (AUC 0.22–0.31; anti-correlated with bar truth within physical ζ), but Πmin robustly tracks disk structural state (ρ[Πmin, log Σ] ≈ −0.71; ρ[Πmin, fgas] ≈ +0.65 on SPARC; replicated on xGASS).
parameters_tested: ζ (entropy-flow coupling) including physical cap from κ_eff^2 ≥ 0 (ζ_max ≈ 1.52 in sample)
entropy-gradient proxy mode: v_squared vs shear
σ_R prescription: Jeans-inspired σ_R(R) = π G Σ(R) R_d vs constant fallback
disk window definition: Πmin over R ∈ [R_d, 3 R_d]
resonance-aware global window (v0.2: ILR, CR, swing-X, peaked window)
α weighting from EFC latency (α = 1 − L, bounded [0.05, 0.95])
datasets_used: SPARC: N = 43 with clean SB/SA morphology for bar classification; N = 112 for disk-state correlations
xGASS: N = 98 SDSS + Arecibo sample independent of SPARC

sealed_predictions.statement: Πmin (or a scalar Πproxy) is negatively correlated with stellar surface density (log Σ) in late-type rotation-supported disks at z ≈ 0.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Compute Spearman (and partial Spearman) correlations between Π (derived from resolved RCs and Σ) and log Σ on ≥1 external, independent galaxy samples; reject if |ρ| < 0.2 or sign is positive at p > 0.05 in all such samples after standard quality cuts.

sealed_predictions.statement: Πmin (or Πproxy) is positively correlated with gas mass fraction fgas in late-type rotation-supported disks at z ≈ 0.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Repeat the correlation test on independent datasets (e.g., HI-selected or IFU surveys) using both decomposition-based and M_HI/(M_HI+M*)-based fgas; reject if |ρ| < 0.2 or sign is negative at p > 0.05 consistently across ≥2 independent samples.

kill_criteria: KC1: If reproducing observed bar fractions or bar/no-bar classifications requires ζ values that violate the κ_eff^2 ≥ 0 constraint anywhere in the disk window for a non-negligible subset of galaxies, the EFC-BIC track is rejected (bar criterion killed).

KC2: If Πmin shows neither a significant anti-correlation with log Σ nor a significant positive correlation with fgas (|ρ| < 0.2, p > 0.05) across at least two independent external samples after standard inclination, quality, and pipeline stratifications, the proposed Π-based disk-state observable is invalidated.

KC3: If partial Spearman tests yield residuals |ρ(Π, log Σ | fgas)| < 0.2 and |ρ(Π, fgas | log Σ)| < 0.2 across multiple independent samples, indicating Π reduces to a single-parameter proxy (or to noise), then the claim of Π as an independent disk-state parameter is rejected.

KC4: If replacing the Jeans-inspired σ_R with resolved stellar/gas dispersion measurements removes the Π–(Σ, fgas) correlations (|ρ| < 0.2) across samples, the interpretation of Π as a physical disk-state parameter is killed.

KC5: If the shear-sign expectation (g_EFC ∝ v R dΩ/dR < 0 in the disk window) is empirically violated in typical late-type disks when measured from high-quality rotation curves, rendering κ_eff unable to reduce Π toward instability, the EFC shear-based formulation is falsified.
